Proof

↗ lem:curve-shrinking-first-variation ↗ claim:curve-shrinking-length-curvature-uniform-bound \sketch Equation (9) bounds $|\partial _ts|$ by an ambient-curvature multiple of $L(\gamma _t)$ plus $\int k^2ds$. Use $k^2\le \sqrt{2/(t-t')}k$, the preceding claim, and $\partial _t\varphi =r^{-1}\psi '\partial _ts$.

□

\begin{claim} \end{claim}[Bound on the cutoff-weighted curvature integral]
